added_claim_errors: 「雇い入れから6か月たつと法律上の有給休暇が付きます」: overstated, because it leaves out the second requirement (80% attendance) under 第39条第1項
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: defers the number to workplace documents when the statutory number is fixed (5 days under 施行規則第24条の3), and a 給与明細 does not necessarily show the leave balance
「急なご相談で申し訳ありません」: the event is next month, so calling it a sudden request is inaccurate (minor wording issue, not a legal error)
Quotes the condition as 「業務の正常な運営を妨げる場合」, but 第39条第5項 and the linked Shizuoka Labour Bureau page (which I opened) say 「事業の正常な運営を妨げる」. Minor misquote
Says 「所定労働日の8割」 where the statute says 全労働日. Close in practice; very minor

reasons: Both answers open by correcting the manager's claim. B gives the specifics a person needs: both statutory requirements, the 5-day grant, the 10月1日 grant date, the 80% attendance condition, and the limit on the employer's 時季変更権. Its LINE message asks for the dated day as 有給休暇 in a polite tone with no threats, and it keeps the fallback steps (就業規則, 労基署, 総合労働相談コーナー) outside the message. I opened B's cited Shizuoka Labour Bureau link and it supports B's content; the only flaw is a small misquote of 事業 as 業務. A leaves out the 80% condition, the number of days and the 時季変更権 point. Its main LINE draft deliberately avoids requesting paid leave, which leaves the person close to the trap. A is shorter, but it is clearly less correct and less usable.
